difficulty_reason: H3: the author must descend arbitrary parahoric-cuspidal data, including grade-wise locally finite families, to nilpotent-supported cuspidal data on connected centralizers. The complete proof controls finite double-coset classes and exact Haar factors, proves all split-center/facet-dimension vanishing and cuspidality branches using finite-group root actions, and cancels the proper-parabolic Arthur weight corrections only after integrating against the descended very-cuspidal functions. The final Lie-algebra realization then gives the maximal nilpotent-Fourier expansion and the retained Levi-induction theorem extends it to all D(G). This full coupled building/finite-group/weighted-orbital descent is supplied, not assumed as background.
